description: Update an investigation record. Update one existing investigation record in place — the write-back seam for the `working` run record you were handed when a run was launched. Fill in the `summary`/`findings`, attach the fixing PR, record your `confidence` and the `sources` you inspected, or flip its `kind` of…

completedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the work finished. Set it (or flip `kind` off `working`) to mark a run record done.

handle.description: A resource path identifier — an opaque `xxx_<ULID>` id (~30 chars) or the resource's `name`/`key`. 1–128 characters; the upper bound matches the longest name/key any resource accepts, so an over-long value can never name a real row.

investigationId.description: A resource path identifier — an opaque `xxx_<ULID>` id (~30 chars) or the resource's `name`/`key`. 1–128 characters; the upper bound matches the longest name/key any resource accepts, so an over-long value can never name a real row.

kind.description: Reclassify the record's lifecycle stage (e.g. flip a `working` run into `investigated` once findings land).

model.description: The model the agent ran on.

qaNotes.description: How to verify the fix — QA notes (markdown).

question.description: A blocking question for the team (markdown).

sessionId.description: The agent-run session id, so the dashboard can deep-link to the run.

items.description: One file/link inspected while producing the record.

visibility.description: Record visibility. `draft` keeps it out of the panel; `published` surfaces it.

name: ops_investigations_update
